items.description: The texts to judge, sent to the judge the operator set. One invoke makes at most the judge calls per step the operator set (twelve unless changed): per chunk of code, one to judge it and one to locate its findings, plus one for the comments.

ref.description: A name for the text, usually its path; its extension names the language when language is absent.

text.description: The source text. Each item must also fit max_file_bytes in UTF-8 bytes (128 KiB by default, at most 192 KiB); the character limit here does not replace that byte limit. Oversized input is refused before inference.

language.description: The language key (go, python, typescript, java, c, cpp, rust, …).
